notes.title: Patch 1.7.3 - Fort Anping
notes.notes:
Ahoy, mateys! 

The development of my next game has been ramping up in recent months, but I finally had the time to finalize the next version of Rum & Gun. Today's content drop is on the slim side, but I hope you'll enjoy it.

EDIT: a mistake was made in the publishing process, resulting in devmode being activated on startup, but the hotfix should be out now. I apologize for the issue.

Full list of changes:

4 new Treasure Hunt tilesets (including a super secret one)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/68683c80bb0819525d36f874545c252f0631eecd.jpg"]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/61839510ddb2fb372d44b9b6db2d2106b821b466.jpg"]

Stash is now accessible on every 10th Treasure Hunt stage

Fixed: Windows GUI scaling is now disabled for the game window. This may result in significantly higher resolution depending on your OS settings

Added key bindings for weapon slots

Fixed: Treasure Hunt map is now regenerated if no valid path exists

Fixed: typo in "Survivor's Hideout" map name

Fixed: wrong shader and shadow model for Seagull pet

Fixed: some uniformed units had wrong uniform in Treasure Hunt

Better east-side camera bounds on Treasure Hunt maps

Added fire doodads to Scorched Jungle Treasure Hunt map type

Fixed: updated an NPC text to be same as the voice line in the Quagmire of the Fallen

Fixed: Added more hero-blocker pathing on the Quagmire of the Fallen

Slight optimization to terrain texture drawing

That's all for now. If any issues arise, please reach out on the Discord server. I'll keep an eye out from now on.



Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.7.1h - Perk system change. More fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
Ahoy, mateys!

Another week, another round of improvements for Rum & Gun. I've been watching your streams of the game and it's been super useful feedback. Also, I've been getting reports of 'unresponsive' controls - if anyone could give more feedback on that, that would be a lifesaver.

Here are the full patch notes:

-One of the perk rolls is now guaranteed to be an upgrade to an already chosen perk (part of a branch)
-Pillage has been reworked to give a powder crate instead of 2 gold (8 second cooldown)
-Currently rolled perks are highlighted and can be selected even in the skill panel. Perk roll panel is now hidden while skill panel is visible
-Modified Fort Bourbon terrain to make sequence breaking less likely
-Added new option to show the reload bar at the cursor
-Gamepad now supports ship boost
-Fixed: weapon item comparisons no longer use the default slot id, but looks for the most similar equipped weapons
-Fixed: two guns of same ammo type caused various bugs (e.g. firespitter and repeater broke reloading)
-Fixed: wrong socket passives were displayed in rune tooltip
-Fixed: bleed immunity from Cure was not working
-Fixed: hanged pirates can no longer be stunned
-Fixed: inventory hint was still mentioning "buying" items
-Fixed: better automatic spell layout when equipping spells in various orders
-Changed default key binding of ship mode from 'H' to 'Z' 
-Fixed: "Show enemy lifebars" setting was not remembered
-Fixed: if second pistol has more spells than main pistol, its spell action buttons were hidden
-Fixed: akimbo main gun's sword action now falls back to primary attack
-Fixed: visible edge of the map on Fort Bourbon
-Auto-aim for gamepads is now disabled while inventory or skill window is open
-Fixed: last patch has disabled active reloads for gamepads
-Fixed: "magazine" rune bonus was renamed to "reload", consistent with weapon tooltips
-Fixed: "reload" socket bonus was not displayed as percentage
-Fixed: keyboard cannons did not work when gamepad was connected
-Fixed: Typo in journal notification
-Slight change to auto-sell algorithm
-Fixed: F12 now brings up console in editor gui, not just while playing in editor mode

That's all for today. As always, if something got broken by the update, don't hesitate to notify me.

Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.7.1d
notes.notes:
Ahoy, mateys!
Yet another small patch, mostly bugfixes and minor adjustments. There was a major bug that made co-op with more than 2 players unplayable. As always, some new bugs could have appeared, so don't hesitate to report any issue!

Full notes:
Ship minimap lifebars now look like regular lifebars
Increased health and reduced attack damage of Tribesman allies
Fixed: co-op with more than 2 players unplayable due to bad dodge vfx syncing
Scroll wheel is now rebindable
Active reload is now separately rebindable from reload (reload still works as active reload)
Fixed: replacing a rune on full inventory would discard the old rune
Minor changes to Ancient Lair zone
Fixed: "Nice Try" perk was bugged, could not be selected
Fixed: Damage limit calculation had all sorts of mistakes
Fixed: typo in Painful Interest perk description

Smooth sailing,
Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.7.1c - Disappearing savegame fix, controller experiments
notes.notes:
Ahoy, mateys!

Launch week is finally over. This has been an amazing 7 days. The influx of new players is already taking the game in better directions. For that I am really thankful. As always, I'll look forward to more of your feedback, be it on balancing, QoL, content, bugs, etc.

Anyways, here are the full patch notes for today:
- Fixed: you can no longer join a multiplayer session without creating/loading a character
- Fixed: default gamepad layout is now for Xbox controllers --- You will need to delete the current config.json file for this to take effect.
- Socket stack size has been increased from 40 to 100
- Fixed: Treasure Hunt achievement progress was counted in a wrong way
- Fixed: Siren sisters could get stuck underwater due to narrow pathing
- Slightly reduced drop rate of shield and planks
- Fixed: bleed and fire resist were displayed as percentages in item tooltips
- Added small explanation to bleed resist perk tooltip
- Added jump-down to Bay of Whispers boss fight so that other players can join after the palisade is up
- New Game panel now starts with an empty name, instead of "Anonymous"
- Fixed: applying weapon upgrades reset their action layout

Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.7.1b - Ship fix and other tweaks

notes.title: Almost there! Pre-release test version available
notes.notes:
Ahoy, mateys! 

Although the full launch of the game will have to wait for another couple of weeks due to unforeseen circumstances, I've uploaded a pre-release beta version to Steam. [strike]You can access it at Properties -> Betas -> pre-release. [/strike] 
EDIT: the pre-release version is now live for everyone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/6fdc5dc5f05c8130707890c6f80d037bef394073.jpg

It's probably the largest update so far, full changelog will come with the official release of the game. Major changes include:
- FULL VOICE ACTING
- The end of Act IV - 3 new levels + Epilogue
- Damage rebalancing. Weapon damage now scales with item level.
- More vendors added
- New weapons, items, spells
- Countless map changes and tweaks
- Countless multiplayer fixes
- 1 new music track
First and foremost I'm looking for feedback on the new damage scaling, and the final maps.

What's next for development ?
- Launch trailer (something very special is in the works)
- Add missing voice lines, replace placeholders
- More achievements
- Multiplayer testing
- Workshop support testing and finalization
- testing, testing, testing....

See you very soon. If all goes well, our next stop will be out of Early Access. Take care until then!
Borington
